subject: Mutual action plan: security gates & close timeline for Tidepool pilot
messages:
From: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@tidepool.ai>, procurement@tidepool.ai
Cc: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Mutual action plan: security gates & close timeline for Tidepool pilot

Hi Alex —

Thanks again for the time today. Per our run-through, I put together a short mutual action plan (MAP) focused on the security/compliance gates we need to clear before the pilot sign-off. High level items we propose to include in the MAP: 

- SOC 2 Type II (most recent report + evidence index) — clarify scope (production vs staging)
- SIG/CAIQ completed questionnaire (or gap matrix)
- Executed DPA with data residency & retention annex
- Retention: default 90 days for model inputs/logs; optional 180/365 for longer-term audit needs; EU residency option if required
- KMS integration & optional HSM for key escrow
- Evidence handoff schedule (who provides what, and by when)

Proposed timeline (target):
- Week 1: security intake & SOC 2 + CAIQ review
- Week 2: legal/DPA redlines
- Week 3: pilot SOW + signatures -> kick-off

I attached a concise MAP checklist (20270614-tidepool-map-checklist.xlsx) and our SOC 2 one‑pager (redwood-soc2-summary.pdf) so your security/legal teams can scan quickly. Can you confirm: (1) if the SOC 2 scope needs to include your production tenant, and (2) whether 90 days retention is acceptable as a starting point?

If it helps I can loop in Markus to answer the CAIQ/staging vs prod questions — looping him here.

Thanks — happy to coordinate a 30-min sync this week.

Best,
Chloe Martin
Field Sales Director | Redwood Inference
chloe.martin@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0123
From: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@tidepool.ai>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Security Ops <security@tidepool.ai>, procurement@tidepool.ai
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mutual action plan: security gates & close timeline for Tidepool pilot

Chloe —

Appreciate the clear plan and the docs. A couple of quick clarifying questions from our side before we map this into our intake system: 

1) SOC 2 scope: does the report you attached cover only Redwood's hosted service (shared infra), or can you provide evidence scoped to a dedicated instance? For our compliance team, production scope is important.
2) CAIQ/SIG: can you provide a completed CAIQ or do you have a gap analysis version? The CAIQ helps us accelerate the technical review.
3) DPA: our legal team will likely redline retention (we usually limit user data/log retention to 90 days for standard pilots). The template DPA clause I want to flag now is around 7-year audit retention — that will probably be a no-go for us.

I’m attaching a quick gap analysis I started (tidepool-sig-gap-analysis.xlsx) — will push to Security Ops for review.

If you can confirm whether you can commit to: production-scope SOC 2 evidence OR a path to provide the required artifacts within 5 business days, and an agreed 90-day retention for pilot telemetry, we can keep the timeline intact. Otherwise we may need an extra week for legal.

Looping procurement so they can attach the intake form to the MAP. Happy to do a 30-min call — how about Wed 10am PT?

Thanks,
Alex Rivera
Head of Integrations | Tidepool Financial
alex.rivera@tidepool.ai

Alex / Chloe —

Quick technical reply to the SOC 2 / CAIQ questions to keep the MAP moving: 

- SOC 2: our Type II covers the hosted service and the controls for production tenancy on our managed offering. We can provide an evidence index scoped to a dedicated customer environment (snapshot of control mappings and sampling evidence) — that typically takes 2-3 business days to assemble. The redwood-soc2-summary.pdf highlights the control families and where we collect evidence.

- CAIQ: we maintain a completed CAIQ in our security repo; for speed I can export a completed CAIQ and a short gap matrix against your tidepool-sig-gap-analysis.xlsx within 3 business days.

- Retention & DPA: default telemetry and input retention is 90 days. For regulated pilots we offer a 180-day option (configurable) and can propose a clause for EU data residency if needed. The 7-year audit retention you mentioned is not our default for pilot telemetry; if legal requires archival for specific user data we prefer to scope that narrowly and use an annex.

- Key mgmt: we support customer-managed keys via KMS and have an HSM-backed option for escrow. If you want, we can include KMS integration steps in the MAP milestone list.

I put a short evidence index file together (soc2-evidence-index.txt) and pushed an internal DRIVE link with sample artifacts: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB2cExampleSOC2Evidence.

If 90 days is acceptable for the pilot, and you accept a production-scoped evidence index in 2-3 business days, we should be able to stick to the Week 1/2/3 plan Chloe outlined.

Cheers,
Markus Klein
Principal Systems Engineer | Redwood Inference
